description: The PB-27 RTO serves the Kharar subdivision in the Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar district of Punjab. As a Sub-Divisional Magistrate office, it handles vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits for the local population. It is a key administrative hub for transport services in the region adjacent to Chandigarh and Mohali.
address: Sub Divisional Office (SDM Office), Kharar, District SAS Nagar, Punjab
